page: Amazon Web Services inf2.8xlarge is an accelerated computing instance built on the AWS Nitro System, architected primarily for deep learning inference workloads. The host configuration features an AMD EPYC 7R13 processor operating at 3.6 GHz on the x86_64 architecture, providing 32 virtual CPUs across 16 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading enabled. System memory consists of 128.0 GB of DDR4 RAM running at 3 GHz, delivering a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is supplied by a single AWS Inferentia2 chip equipped with 32 GB of dedicated accelerator memory. Local instance storage is not included, requiring external block storage for persistent data, while networking capabilities provide a 17 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Benchmark measurements indicate solid computational and memory throughput across general and specialized tests. The AMD EPYC processor achieves a strong single-core stress-ng result of 2991.39 and an encryption score of 37952.63 in PassMark, alongside a multi-core Geekbench score of 13860.0. Memory subsystems demonstrate strong throughput with a PassMark memory score of 2877.72 and uncached 256MB block read throughput of 78.67 GB/sec. In machine learning inference evaluations, the server achieves 2098.23 prompt processing tokens per second and 256.61 generation tokens per second on lightweight 135M parameter models. Throughput registers at 71.08 prompt tokens per second and 14.46 generation tokens per second for 7B parameter architectures, whereas larger 70B parameter models drop significantly to 7.08 prompt tokens per second.

From an infrastructure efficiency standpoint, the inf2.8xlarge eliminates the capital premium associated with general-purpose flagship GPUs by utilizing specialized Inferentia2 silicon. However, the 32 GB accelerator memory boundary poses a functional tradeoff, restricting its operational efficiency on dense, large-parameter foundation models without multi-node distribution. This makes the instance suitable for production serving of small to medium natural language processing models, computer vision tasks, transformer-based embeddings, and real-time API inference pipelines.
description: Amazon Web Services inf2.8xlarge is an accelerated computing instance optimized for machine learning inference workloads. Running on the AWS Nitro System, the instance provides 32 vCPUs and 16 physical cores powered by an AMD EPYC 7R13 processor clocked at 3.6 GHz, paired with 128.0 GB of DDR4 system memory. Acceleration is delivered via a dedicated AWS Inferentia2 chip offering 32 GB of high-bandwidth device memory. The server relies entirely on remote storage, supported by a baseline network bandwidth of 17 Gbps. Benchmark evaluations demonstrate strong CPU encryption performance and solid memory throughput, alongside practical inference speeds on small to medium deep learning models, such as 256.61 text generation tokens per second on 135M architectures. The instance provides an efficient hardware footprint for deploying transformer models, conversational agents, real-time recommendation engines, and high-throughput API endpoints.
